limitations: По среднесписочной численности последний извлечённый год2024; отраслевой численностиG/H нет. По отраслевым зарплатам есть2023–2024, сохранив накопленные периоды.
No observation of where workers reside or intersettlement travel; workplace aggregate cannot identify dependence of surroundings.

Official municipal names are geographical units; current one-settlement composition is checked against five existing registry vintages, but continuous boundary stability2017–2024 is not independently established.
Comparison cities selected for same region, city-district level, fixed cohort and available consistent source; absence of platform logistics and common pretrends not established.
Search-index extraction is inspectable but lower confidence than direct PDF extraction; repeat when primary host available.
